app.title: Autional Config Console
audit.title: Audit Logs
audit.description: Configuration admin operations, including plaintext reveals (admin_reveal).
audit.mock: Audit queries are unavailable in demo mode.
console.forbiddenTitle: No access to the Config Console
console.forbiddenHint: This account is missing the config:read permission.
login.title: Sign in to manage configuration
login.description: The admin API requires a JWT: config:read to read, config:write to write, config:publish to roll back.
login.oidcAction: Sign in with an Autional account
overview.title: Config Console overview
overview.description: Organised as domain → group → item. Domains are for navigation and statistics; edits happen in groups.
overview.structure.domain: Domain: a top-level category used only for navigation and statistics.
overview.structure.group: Group: the editing unit — one form per group.
overview.structure.item: Item: the write unit — every item has its own revision.
overview.structure.effective: Resolution: a service inherits the platform base unless it defines the key, in which case it overrides it.
overview.resetHint: This clears the local demo changes.
domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Browse groups by domain and open a group to edit.
domains.detailFallback: Groups and items in this domain.
domains.inheritHint: A service inherits the platform base unless it defines the key, in which case it overrides it. Keys with different values are flagged.
group.noEditorNote: This group has no custom form; the default form is used.
group.defaultForm: No custom editor for this group: every item is listed under “Other items” and can be edited individually.
group.editorFallback: The server editor schema is unavailable; falling back to the local registry.
group.secretRefHint: The value lives in the Secret Center; only the key name is shown here.
group.otherEmpty: No items in this group fall outside the custom form.
item.needReveal: Reveal the plaintext in the item details before editing.
item.revealedFilled: Filled with the plaintext revealed in this session; you will need to reveal it again after saving.
placement.consumers: Impact: {{count}} services may read this key
placement.deleteConfirm: Delete the value at this placement?
reveal.title: Reveal plaintext
reveal.description: This reveal is audited (admin_reveal); the plaintext is shown only in this page's memory and is hidden automatically after 30 seconds.
reveal.forbidden: config:write is required to reveal plaintext.
reason.title: Reason for change
reason.placeholder: e.g. debugging gateway logs / rolling out new pool settings
write.rollbackHint: Rolls the key back to revision {{revision}} (creates a new revision; can be rolled back again).
changes.title: Change log
changes.description: History and audit trail of configuration items.
changes.demoHint: Demo data has no backend history. Connect the live API (VITE_DATA_MODE=api) to see the cross-service change trail.
changesets.title: Change sets
changesets.description: Submit a batch of changes as one change set, then publish or reject it.
changesets.demoHint: Demo data has no change sets. Connect the live API to review, publish, or reject drafts.
changesets.col.title: Title
changesets.col.creator: Created by
changesets.reasonHint: Publishing or rejecting is audited; provide a reason (1–200 characters).
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The link may be stale, or the group no longer exists.
import.title: Import configuration
import.hint: Accepts JSON / YAML (an export file or an equivalent structure). The preview is read-only.
import.replaceExisting: Overwrite existing keys (otherwise only missing items are added)
import.readOnly: Demo mode: preview works, writes require the live API.
import.changesetSaved: Saved as a draft change set: {{title}}
import.applyHint: Writes the previewed changes to the Config Center and records the reason in the audit log.
import.partial: {{count}} entries failed; the rest were written
banner.demo: Demo data: key names, hierarchy, and counts come from a real Config Center preflight (2,020 unique keys); values are masked. Edits are stored in your browser.
banner.api: Connected to the live Config Center API ({{base}}): config:read to read, config:write with a reason to write, config:publish to roll back.
